composites.name: rung3-flexible-mem3dg-boundary
composites.description: Closed Mem3DG icosphere vesicle inflating under bonded actin pushing radially outward (spec §2.2 #3). Phase-2 endpoint: full mem3dg ↔ readdy bidirectional handshake.

composites.name: rung2-rigid-movable-boundary
composites.description: Wall translates under integrated contact force using drag-balance kinematics. Reproduces Peskin 1993 setup (spec §2.2 #2).

composites.name: rung1-fixed-boundary
composites.description: Actin pushes against a wall held at fixed z (spec §2.2 #1). Brownian-ratchet kinetics against an immovable boundary; barrier_velocity is zero by construction.
